mechanism_and_quality_notes: Brick-red jobs/demand, candidate records, interviews/feedback and offers feed an exposed evidence/context lens. Qualitative recommendations meet a navy recruiter-approval boundary before authorized action. Ungated paths stop at the boundary; vendor-announcement caveat is detached. Equal-size tokens avoid invented scores; no fake feedback writing, people, autonomous advancement or fairness guarantee.
